title: Feature Status (team layout)
description: State of one feature directory under features/<id>/. IDs embed their allocator — a date or a ticket key — so parallel branches never mint the same ID.

id.description: feat-<YYYYMMDD>-<slug> (local-first) or feat-<TICKET-KEY>-<slug> (tracker-allocated). Never a bare running number.

project.description: Sub-project this feature belongs to, for multi-project repos ('all' if repo-wide)

dependencies.description: Feature IDs that must be done before this one

phase.description: Workflow phase, e.g. planned / spec / build / verify / done

owner.description: Who claimed this feature. Empty = unclaimed.

branch.description: Branch the claim was made on

evidence.description: Verification evidence when status is 'done': commands run, output, dates, known limitations
